description: Read-only 100,000 distinct dictionary-word bulk test of the exact synonym and direct WordNet relation matching layer. Not a full matcher invocation per word and not an AI accuracy benchmark.

method.source: Existing Open English WordNet membership and relation tables
method.sampling: Deterministic md5(guess || ':ascent-100k-v1') sampling, 60,000 synonym pairs, 15,000 direct dictionary edges with hypernym child count <=35, 15,000 identical displayed-clue controls, 10,000 random unlabeled pairs, disjoint guess sets.
method.evaluation: Set-based version of one-hop dictionary matching and displayed-clue guards, using actual guess_forms and clue_terms functions; no new connections inserted. Multi-hop, other local scoring layers and model inference not included.
method.limitations: Dictionary is also used by matcher, so this checks coverage of known lexical relations, not independent semantic generalization. Random pairings have no independently validated negative labels.

actual_function_checks.test: 1,000 distinct dictionary synonym pairs with guesses beginning with a, excluding displayed clues
